newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ weekly movement drops to 4.724 mln gallons.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ weekly movement drops to 4.724 mln gallons.

text.p: The Florida Citrus Processors Association said frozen concentrated orange juice movement into trade channels for the week ended March 22 was 4,724,212 gallons compared with 6,121,429 gallons last week.
Imports were 2,631,557 gallons compared with 734,141 gallons the previous week. There were 80,782 domestic receipts for this week compared with 38,939 the previous week.
Retail movement was 842,580 gallons, while bulk movement was 3,358,597 gallons.
Current season cumulative movement was 86,059,076 gallons.
The final total pack for the season is 163,087,328 gallons.
